name: build-realitykit
description: Build cross-platform RealityKit scenes, systems, rendering, animation, physics, audio, and USDKit runtime flows for Apple platforms.

interface.shortDescription: Build RealityKit scenes, systems, rendering, animation, physics, audio, and USDKit runtime flows
interface.longDescription: Cross-platform RealityKit implementation for Apple platforms: task routing, scene setup, entity loading, interaction and accessibility, SwiftUI attachments, anchoring and portals, rendering and materials, animation and physics, spatial audio, custom ECS systems, USDKit runtime stages, installed-SDK API lookup, and runtime handoff from authored Reality Composer Pro 3 assets. Use alongside Build visionOS 27 apps for platform app structure, Profile & Optimize RealityKit for measured runtime performance investigations, and Build with Reality Composer Pro 3 for authored graph and package work.
defaultPrompt: Build a RealityKit scene with documented entities, components, systems, and runtime ownership.
Implement a measured RealityKit rendering, animation, physics, audio, ECS, or USDKit runtime fix.
Route profiling, Instruments traces, high CPU or GPU, memory growth, and performance verification to Profile & Optimize RealityKit.
Route authored Reality Composer Pro 3 graph/package work to Build with Reality Composer Pro 3 when needed.
